components.name: Modal
components.description: Centred dialog panel. One axis, Size, because a confirmation, a form and a lightbox differ in CONTENT not frame (26.1); the destructive confirm is an instance recipe (Footer/Primary Variant=Danger + showClose=false), never a variant. The canvas footprint of every variant is the PANEL ALONE: the 48% scrim is a separate full-viewport Overlay layer in the two layoutFrames, bound to color/bg/overlay, never baked into the panel. Header and Footer are HUG and pinned; Body is the only scrolling region (clip content ON, prototype overflow Vertical, maxHeight derived from the 852px panel cap). Footer order is Secondary then Primary, right-aligned, both Size=Medium HUG; on mobile (<768px) every Modal except a destructive confirm renders as Drawer Side=Bottom (26.6), and the destructive confirm stacks its footer Primary-on-top FILL Size=Large (26.5). Radius radius/xl, elevation e4, fill color/bg/surface; no border in light mode, 1px color/border/default added as an instance override on the dark board. A11y: role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby=Title (a Modal with no title is a defect), focus moves to the CONTAINER on open, real focus trap plus inert on the app root, focus returns to the opener on close, Esc closes (on a destructive confirm Esc fires the SECONDARY action instead of being swallowed), scroll lock via overflow:hidden on html, Body gets tabindex=0 when it overflows. Bangla: WRAP — widths unchanged (400/560/720), title wraps to 2 lines (cap 48 chars), description 2 lines, body unbounded and scrolls. Motion: desktop enter scale .96->1 + opacity 200ms standard, exit scale 1->.98 + opacity 120ms; reduced motion = opacity only 120ms. Spring easing is forbidden. backdrop-filter is forbidden. Modals never nest.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Edge-anchored dialog panel. Side x Size = 9. Side=Right (default) is the desktop cart, filter panel and admin detail pane; Side=Left is ONLY the storefront mobile navigation and the admin off-canvas sidebar; Side=Bottom is every mobile sheet including the mobile form of Modal. Right/Left are FIXED width 400/480/640 and 100dvh tall (FIXED 900 inside the set so the variant has a footprint; FILL in every composition) with radius/xl on the two INNER corners only; Bottom is full-width with ZERO side gutters, radius/2xl on the top corners, a 40x4 grab handle (color/border/strong, 12px above and below, 44px hit band, aria-hidden) and heights HUG-to-50dvh (Small) / HUG-to-85dvh (Medium) / FIXED 90dvh (Large). Padding scale is space/6 on side drawers and space/4 on the bottom sheet. Header (Title + Description + Close IconButton) and Footer (sticky, color/bg/surface, 1px color/border/default top edge, FILL-width Button Size=Large, Primary above an optional Secondary) are HUG and pinned; Body is the single scroll region. The scrim is a separate full-viewport Overlay bound to color/bg/overlay in the layoutFrames — never part of the panel. THE CART (Side=Right Medium / Side=Bottom Medium) CARRIES EXACTLY ONE CROSS-SELL RAIL AND NO UPSELL SLOT (CLAUDE.md 25b); the rail is a named empty FRAME in the composition, not a component layer. A11y: role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby=Title; same contract as Modal (focus to container, trap, inert, return focus, Esc, scroll lock); the Left nav drawer is ALSO aria-modal with a trap; the handle is never the only dismiss affordance; drag-to-dismiss has keyboard (Esc) and pointer (Close, overlay) equivalents (WCAG 2.5.7); overscroll-behavior: contain on Body; dvh never vh. Motion: side drawers translateX(+/-100%->0) 240ms decelerate in, 200ms standard out; bottom sheet translateY(100%->0) 240ms decelerate in, 200ms standard out; reduced motion = opacity only 120ms. Drag-to-dismiss on Bottom only: grab area = handle + header (never the body), threshold 25% of height or 0.5px/ms, overlay opacity tracks drag, no snap points, upward drag rubber-bands at 0.3x. Bangla: widths unchanged, header and footer labels WRAP/GROW, bodies grow and scroll; title cap 40 chars, footer button cap 24.

notes: CONVENTION / descriptor values: a STRING on gap / padding / cornerRadiusToken / strokeWeight / fillToken / strokeToken / effectStyle / textStyle is the exact Figma variable or style name to BIND; a NUMBER on gap / padding / size / minHeight / maxHeight is raw px (board-derived caps and untokenised control dimensions). fillToken: null / strokeToken: null = remove that paint. Later children paint ON TOP, so _edge / _scroll-edge / _focus are declared last in their parent. absolute.inset omits an edge when it is unconstrained; constraints is {horizontal, vertical} per the brief.

CONVENTION / per-corner radius: where cornerRadiusToken is an OBJECT {tl,tr,br,bl} each key names a radius variable to bind to topLeftRadius / topRightRadius / bottomRightRadius / bottomLeftRadius individually (radius/none = 0). Used on every Drawer variant: Side=Right binds radius/xl to tl+bl, Side=Left to tr+br, Side=Bottom binds radius/2xl to tl+tr. All four are individually variable-bindable in the Plugin API; never type 24 or 32.

CONVENTION / isExposedInstance: true on a COMPONENT_INSTANCE layer means set instance.isExposedInstance = true so the nested component's own properties (Button label / Variant / iconLeft..., IconButton ariaLabel / icon) surface in the Modal/Drawer property panel. This is how primaryLabel, secondaryLabel and the destructive Danger swap are delivered - see the DEVIATION notes. Applied to Header/Close, Footer/Primary and Footer/Secondary on both sets.

CONVENTION / documentationInstances override keys: a bare key (title, showClose) is a set-level property; a 'Layer/Path.prop' key (Footer/Primary.label, Footer/Primary.Variant, Header/Close.ariaLabel) is a property on an EXPOSED nested instance; a 'Layer/Path.textStyle' key is a direct text-style override on an instance text layer (legal, no property owns it) used for the Bangla documentation pairs.

CONVENTION / scrolling body: Figma has no scroll key. Every layer named Body has clipsContent: true AND must get the prototype setting Overflow scrolling = Vertical. On HUG-height panels (Modal, Drawer Side=Bottom Small/Medium) Body is HUG with a maxHeight so the panel is short when content is short and clips/scrolls when it is long; on FIXED-height panels (Drawer Right/Left, Bottom Large) Body is FILL and needs no max. A FILL child cannot sit in a HUG parent in Figma, which is why the spec's 'Body FILL x FILL' (26.8) is realised as HUG+maxHeight on the HUG panels - behaviour is identical.

CONVENTION / strokeDash: the `Content`, `CartLines` and `CrossSellRail` placeholder frames carry strokeDash [6,6] (dashPattern) on a 1px color/border/default INSIDE stroke so a slot reads as a slot and is never shipped as UI. The placeholders exist because an instance cannot receive children: real content goes on a composition (detached, or Tier 2 components dropped next to the instance), never inside the set.

CONVENTION / layer opacity: the `Overlay` RECTANGLE in every composition is layer opacity 100% with fill color/bg/overlay (the token carries the overlay alpha per mode). Nav-row `_scrim` layers are authored visible at layer opacity 0%; hover 8%, pressed 12%. `Body/_focus` has no opacity; it is visible:false and property-bound.

TOKEN REMAP / spacing: the spec writes spacing/N; every gap and padding here already uses the real space/N names. spacing/1->space/1 (4), /2->space/2 (8), /3->space/3 (12), /4->space/4 (16), /6->space/6 (24).

TOKEN REMAP / radius: the spec's parenthetical px values are stale - it writes radius/xl (20) and radius/2xl (28); the file has radius/xl = 24 and radius/2xl = 32. The token NAMES are authoritative: Modal and side Drawers bind radius/xl, the bottom sheet binds radius/2xl, exactly as the spec names them. Do not hand-enter 20 or 28.

TOKEN REMAP / typography: the spec's en/h3 '18 / 1.3 / 600 (20 on desktop)' maps to Latin/Mobile/h3 (18) on mobile surfaces and Latin/Desktop/h3 (21) on desktop surfaces. No 20px heading exists in the file and a parallel Latin/Modal/Title at 20 would fork the type scale for 1px, so none is created (newTextStyles is empty). en/body-sm -> Latin/Desktop/body-sm or Latin/Mobile/body-sm (both 14). Surface mapping: Modal and Drawer Side=Right = Desktop styles; Drawer Side=Left (mobile nav / admin off-canvas, both <1024) and Side=Bottom = Mobile styles. The .lang-bn build swaps to the parallel Bangla/* style of the same name.

CONFLICT / overlay colour: spec 26.4 and 27.6 fill the overlay with color/text/primary at 48% layer opacity; the brief binds the scrim to color/bg/overlay. The brief wins - every Overlay layer is fillToken color/bg/overlay at layer opacity 100%. The token is the per-mode overlay colour (warm-tinted neutral, not pure black, per the spec's own reasoning) and already carries its alpha. IF the lead finds color/bg/overlay resolves to an OPAQUE colour in the Color collection, set that layer's opacity to 48% and record it; never substitute color/text/primary.

CONFLICT / Drawer.showHandle (27.2 'true on Side=Bottom, false otherwise'): a Figma component property has ONE default across the set (brief binding decision 3), so showHandle is NOT a property. The Handle frame exists in all 9 variants and its `visible` is set PER VARIANT: true on the three Side=Bottom variants, false on Right/Left. Because no property owns it, a designer toggles it directly on an instance. Code keeps showHandle as a prop with the per-side default.

CONFLICT / Modal.destructive (26.2 'Footer > Primary -> Variant=Danger; showClose forced false'): a BOOLEAN property cannot swap a nested instance's variant, and one property cannot drive another. destructive is therefore an INSTANCE RECIPE, not a property: on Footer/Primary (exposed) set Variant=Danger and label 'Cancel order'; set showClose=false; set Footer/Secondary label to the affirmative keep-action ('Keep order'). Built as the documentation instance 'Modal / destructive confirm' and as the mobile composition. Code keeps `destructive` as the single prop that does all three.

DEVIATION / primaryLabel + secondaryLabel (26.2): the Plugin API cannot bind a parent TEXT property to a nested instance's text property (componentPropertyReferences.characters is TEXT-node-only). They are delivered by exposing the Button instances (isExposedInstance = true on Footer/Primary and Footer/Secondary), so the Modal/Drawer property panel shows 'Primary > label' and 'Secondary > label' directly beneath the set-level properties. Same mechanism gives 'Close > ariaLabel' for localisation. Defaults as authored on the instances: Modal 'Confirm' / 'Cancel'; Drawer 'Checkout' / 'Continue shopping'.

DEVIATION / bodySlot INSTANCE_SWAP (26.2, default `Modal/BodyPlaceholder`): DROPPED, following the Avatar.imageSwap precedent in manifest 05. The default component does not exist in the file and nothing may be invented; buildOrder is fixed to Modal, Drawer. Body/Content is instead a dashed placeholder FRAME (color/bg/subtle, radius/md, FILL x FIXED 160, centred _slot-label caption in color/text/tertiary). If a `Modal/BodyPlaceholder` component is created later, add the property then and bind it to Body/Content.mainComponent.

DEVIATION / Drawer.footerSticky (27.2): a boolean cannot move Footer from being Body's sibling (pinned) to Body's last child (scrolls away). Built STICKY only - the spec's default and the only form the cart, filters and admin panes use. footerSticky stays a code prop; a non-sticky footer is composed on the board by placing the Button inside the body slot.

DEVIATION / Drawer.showSecondary default = false (26.2 via 27.2 says true): every Drawer footer in production holds one FILL Button Size=Large ('Checkout', 'Show 128 results', 'Book courier'); the Secondary exists for the admin order pane and the Modal-as-sheet case and is switched on per instance. One default per set, so the common case wins. Modal keeps true.

DEVIATION / Drawer footer layout: 27.8 writes 'vertical | horizontal'. Built VERTICAL on all nine variants: Primary (Variant=Primary Size=Large FILL) above Secondary (Variant=Secondary Size=Large FILL, hidden by default), gap space/2. Primary-on-top is the same thumb-distance reasoning as Modal 26.5 and is what the cart and filter sheets need; a right-aligned HUG pair is a Modal pattern, and a drawer that needs it is a Modal.

DEVIATION / Modal title block (26.9 states 332px of title width at Small): the real Title measure is 400 - 48 padding - 16 gap - 44 Close = 292 at Small, 452 at Medium, 612 at Large. The spec's arithmetic omitted the header gap. The Bangla wrap conclusions are unchanged (the 41-char worst case still wraps to exactly 2 lines).

DECISION / Body focus ring: Body receives tabindex=0 when it overflows (26.11), so it is a real tab stop and needs a visible ring. Because the panel clips content, the standard -4px outside `_focus` would be sheared off, so Body/_focus is inset 0 with the 2px color/border/focus stroke aligned INSIDE at radius/none, bound to the BOOLEAN focusVisibleBody (default false). It is the only _focus the panel itself carries; Close and the footer Buttons bring their own via their nested focusVisible. No _scrim and no _aria-label on the panel: it is a container, not a control, and its accessible name is aria-labelledby -> Title.

DECISION / Drawer Side=Left width on narrow viewports (spec silent): width = min(Size width, 100dvw - 56px) so at least a 56px band of Overlay remains as the tap-to-dismiss affordance (>= 44px target). On the 390 board that is 334, which is what the mobile Left-nav composition shows; the set variant stays 400 FIXED. Same clamp applies to Side=Right on tablets.

DECISION / Modal Footer and Drawer Footer carry fillToken color/bg/surface (spec states it only for the Drawer sticky footer). In code the body scrolls UNDER the pinned footer, so the footer must be opaque; a null fill would show scrolled content through it. Header stays null - the scroll-edge hairline is enough and the header does not overlap scrolled content.

DECISION / scroll-edge hairlines (26.3): `Header/_scroll-edge` (bottom 0) and `Footer/_scroll-edge` (top 0) are FILL x 1 RECTANGLEs in color/border/default, visible:false and NOT property-bound - they are shown only while Body is scrolled away from that edge, a runtime state, so a designer toggles them directly on a 'scrolled' mockup. On Drawer the footer line is ALWAYS on and is therefore named `_edge` (visible:true); Drawer's header keeps a hidden `_scroll-edge`.

DECISION / dark-mode border (26.3 'none in light mode; 1px color/border/default in dark mode'): a stroke cannot be conditional on a mode, and a hairline that is transparent in light does not exist as a token. The panel ships with strokeToken: null; on the dark documentation board add a 1px color/border/default INSIDE stroke as an instance override and swap effectStyle to Elevation/Dark/e4. Record both on the board label.

DECISION / Drawer Side=Right and Side=Left variants are FIXED 900 tall inside the set (the 1440x900 board height) because a variant cannot be FILL; in every composition the instance is resized to the viewport height (900 desktop, 844 mobile) - in code it is 100dvh, pinned top and bottom. Side=Bottom variants are FIXED 390 wide (the mobile board width); in code width is FILL with zero side gutters.

DERIVE: Modal panel maxHeight 852 = 900 - 2 x 24 (the desktop board's calc(100dvh - 48px)); Modal Body maxHeight 684 = 852 - Header 84 - Footer 84. Recompute from the rendered Header/Footer absoluteBoundingBox heights if the fonts render differently; the code value is the calc, not the number.

DERIVE: Modal desktop composition instance offset x 440 = (1440 - 560) / 2, y 286 = (900 - 328) / 2 where 328 is the rendered default panel height (Header 84 + Body 160 + Footer 84). With showDescription=true the panel is ~353 tall; re-centre from the live height.

DERIVE: Modal mobile composition panel y 247 = (844 - 350) / 2, where 350 = Header 110 (24 + title 24 + gap 4 + 2-line description 42 + 16) + Body 88 + Footer 152 (16 + 52 + 8 + 52 + 24). Compute from the rendered panel height after the Bangla/Latin text settles.

DERIVE: Drawer Side=Bottom maxHeights 422 (Small, 50dvh) and 717 (Medium, 85dvh) and the Large FIXED height 760 (90dvh) are percentages of the 844 mobile board; Bottom Small/Medium Body maxHeight = panel max - Handle 28 - Header 60 - Footer 84 (250 / 545). Right/Left Body height 724 = 900 - 84 - 92; Bottom Large Body 588 = 760 - 28 - 60 - 84. All of these follow the rendered sibling heights, not the typed numbers.

DERIVE: Drawer cart composition Header 92 = 24 + (27 + 4 + 21) + 16 with the description visible, Footer 158 = 16 + Totals 24 + 12 + DeliveryNote 18 + 12 + Button 52 + 24, Body 650 = 900 - 92 - 158. Left-nav composition Body 668 = 844 - 84 - 92.

GEOMETRY / Modal (all three variants): root VERTICAL, FIXED width 400 / 560 / 720 x HUG, padding 0, gap 0, clip content TRUE, radius/xl, Elevation/Light/e4, fill color/bg/surface, no stroke. Header HORIZONTAL FILL x HUG, counter MIN (top), padding t space/6 r space/6 b space/4 l space/6, gap space/4, clip FALSE; TextBlock VERTICAL FILL x HUG gap space/1; Close = IconButton Variant=Ghost Size=Medium 44x44 icon/x. Body VERTICAL FILL x HUG, padding X space/6 Y 0, gap space/4, clip TRUE, maxHeight 684. Footer HORIZONTAL FILL x HUG, primary MAX (right), counter CENTER, padding t space/4 r space/6 b space/6 l space/6, gap space/3, order Secondary (Variant=Secondary Size=Medium HUG, ~84 wide) then Primary (Variant=Primary Size=Medium HUG, ~96 wide). Default rendered height 328.

GEOMETRY / Drawer Side=Right and Side=Left: root VERTICAL FIXED 400 / 480 / 640 x FIXED 900, clip TRUE, e4, fill color/bg/surface, per-corner radius (see CONVENTION). Handle present but hidden. Header padding t space/6 r space/6 b space/4 l space/6 (84 tall); Body padding X space/6, FILL height; Footer VERTICAL padding t space/4 r space/6 b space/6 l space/6 gap space/2 (92 tall) with _edge on top. Right uses Latin/Desktop styles, Left uses Latin/Mobile styles.

GEOMETRY / Drawer Side=Bottom: root VERTICAL FIXED 390 x HUG (Small maxHeight 422, Medium maxHeight 717) or FIXED 760 (Large), clip TRUE, e4, radius/2xl on tl + tr only. Handle FILL x HUG padding Y space/3, primary CENTER: _bar 40x4 radius/full color/border/strong + hidden _hit44 (FILL x 44, inset t -8 b -8, not a property). Header padding t 0 r space/4 b space/4 l space/4 (60 tall - the handle's 12px supplies the top); Body padding X space/4; Footer VERTICAL padding space/4 all round gap space/2 (84 tall) + _edge; code adds env(safe-area-inset-bottom) to the footer's bottom padding. Side gutters are ZERO.

PLACEMENT / canvas grid with >= 40px gaps, nothing overlapping. Modal set: one row, Small at x 0, Medium at x 440, Large at x 1040; all y 0; footprint 1760 x 328. Drawer set: row 1 Side=Right at y 0 (Small x 0, Medium x 440, Large x 960), row 2 Side=Left at y 940 (same x), row 3 Side=Bottom at y 1880 (Small x 0, Medium x 430, Large x 860); footprint 1600 x 2640. Every variant's footprint is the panel alone - no scrim, no absolute children outside the panel bounds (Body/_focus is inset 0, _hit44 is hidden and inside the Handle's 44px band which sits within the panel).

PLACEMENT / layoutFrames: five compositions, each a sealed FIXED frame with clip content TRUE so nothing spills: Modal / desktop composition 1440x900; Modal / mobile composition 390x844; Drawer / mobile composition 390x844; Drawer / desktop composition 1440x900; Drawer / responsive pair 950x900. Place them in one row below the sets with 80px gaps. The Overlay inside each is a full-frame RECTANGLE at inset 0 and is the scrim; it exists only in compositions, never in a set. Promote it to a local `Overlay` component if reuse is wanted - not in buildOrder.

FOOTER ORDER / Modal desktop: Secondary left, Primary right, right-aligned - the committing action sits where the reading eye finishes. Destructive confirm: Primary is Variant=Danger 'Cancel order', Secondary is the affirmative 'Keep order' - the safe choice is the one with the neutral styling and the word 'Keep', never a second negative ('Don't cancel'). Mobile (<768): stacked, Primary ON TOP, both FILL Size=Large, gap space/2 - the resting thumb sits at the bottom, so the committing action is the position AWAY from it (26.5). Drawer footers are the same stack at every Side.

A11Y / dialog contract (Modal 26.11 and Drawer 27.11): <div role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby=Title aria-describedby=Description tabindex=-1>. On open focus moves to the CONTAINER (so title + description are announced before content), not to the first input and not to Close - the single exception is an OTP modal whose entire content is the field. Real focus trap on Tab / Shift+Tab, PLUS `inert` on the application root (with the polyfill for older Android WebView) - aria-hidden alone leaves the background clickable and inert alone is not universal. On close focus returns to the opener; if the opener is gone (deleted row) focus goes to the nearest surviving landmark heading, never <body>. Scroll lock = overflow:hidden on <html> with scroll-position restore; never position:fixed on <body> (loses the scroll position on Android Chrome).

A11Y / Escape: closes every Modal and Drawer. On a destructive confirm Esc is NOT swallowed - it activates the SECONDARY ('Keep order') action, because swallowing Esc fails WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap. Overlay click closes unless destructive or the body holds dirty form state. Body gets tabindex=0 only when it overflows so arrow keys scroll it without a focusable child; that is the focusVisibleBody ring.

A11Y / destructive confirmation gate: the body carries an Input in which the user types the order number (or product name); Footer/Primary stays genuinely `disabled` (not aria-disabled - the field's own label explains it) until the typed value matches exactly. Button has no disabled property in the file; represent the disabled Danger button on the board with the section 0.4 instance overrides (color/bg/disabled fill, color/text/disabled label, no scrim, no shadow).

A11Y / Drawer specifics: the Side=Left navigation drawer is ALSO aria-modal with a trap - a nav drawer that leaves the page behind it focusable lets a keyboard user tab under an opaque overlay. The Handle is aria-hidden; it is a touch affordance and NEVER the only dismiss affordance - Close and Esc are always present on Side=Bottom even with the handle shown. Drag-to-dismiss has a keyboard equivalent (Esc) and a pointer equivalent (Close, overlay), so it is an enhancement under WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements. overscroll-behavior: contain on Body so reaching its end does not scroll the page. All heights use dvh never vh (Android Chrome's retracting URL bar makes an 85vh sheet taller than the visible viewport and hides its own footer). The filter count in 'Show 128 results' lives in the panel's aria-live=polite region so each facet toggle announces once.

A11Y / touch targets: Close 44x44 (IconButton Medium) passes; footer Buttons 44 tall x >= 96 (desktop) or 52 x FILL (mobile / drawer) pass; nav rows minHeight 44 pass; the grab handle's visual 40x4 is covered by the hidden _hit44 band (FILL x 44 centred on the bar) and the whole header is also a drag surface (~84px); the Overlay band is >= 56px on every composition. Close sits space/4 (16) from the title block so a two-line title's last line never falls under its 44px area.

MOTION / Modal desktop: enter scale(.96)->1 + opacity 0->1, base 200ms standard cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), transform-origin centre; exit scale(1)->.98 + opacity ->0, fast 120ms. Overlay: opacity 0->target over base 200ms standard in, fast 120ms out, backdrop-filter NONE (forbidden - a full-screen GPU readback per frame on mid-range Android). Reduced motion: opacity only, 120ms, no scale, no translate. No spring anywhere - 'a modal that bounces is a modal a parent does not trust with a payment'.

MOTION / Modal as mobile sheet and Drawer Side=Bottom: enter translateY(100%)->0, 240ms decelerate cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1); exit translateY(0->100%), 200ms standard. Drawer Side=Right translateX(100%->0) / Side=Left translateX(-100%->0), 240ms decelerate in, 200ms standard out. Reduced motion for all: opacity only 120ms, no translate. Overlay as per Modal; on Side=Bottom the overlay opacity additionally tracks the drag as target x (1 - progress).

MOTION / drag-to-dismiss (Side=Bottom only, 27.5): grab area = Handle + Header (full width x ~84px), NEVER the Body which must scroll; touch-action none on handle/header, pan-y on body. Dismiss when drag > 25% of sheet height OR release velocity > 0.5px/ms downward; below threshold the sheet returns over base 200ms standard (NOT the spring curve). Upward drag rubber-bands at 0.3x; there are NO snap points and the sheet never expands - one sheet, one height. Body scrolled to top + drag on body does NOT move the sheet. Reduced motion: drag still works (direct manipulation), spring-back and dismiss become opacity-only. Not enabled on pointer devices or on Right/Left.

BANGLA / Modal (26.9, WRAP): widths stay 400 / 560 / 720 in both builds - widening would change every body layout's measure; growing vertically is free because Body scrolls. 'Size & age guide' -> 'সাইজ ও বয়স নির্দেশিকা' is one line at 292px; the worst case 'Confirm you want to cancel this order' -> 'আপনি কি সত্যিই এই অর্ডারটি বাতিল করতে চান?' wraps to 2 lines at Bangla/Desktop/h3 (21 x 1.3 x 1.15 = 31.4px/line), the header grows ~27px (HUG), Body shrinks by the same and scrolls. Footer: 'Cancel' -> 'বাতিল করুন' (~104px) and 'Confirm' -> 'নিশ্চিত করুন' (~124px) GROW as HUG buttons: 228 + 12 gap = 240 inside the 352px Small footer. Title cap 48 Bangla characters. Bangla line-height is 1.15x Latin via the Bangla/* styles, never a global line-height; numerals stay Western (TM-48213, ৳ 3,450).

BANGLA / Drawer (27.9): widths unchanged (480 with space/6 gives a 432 measure; the longest facet label 'শিক্ষামূলক ও বিজ্ঞানভিত্তিক খেলনা' fits one line). Bottom-sheet title measure = 390 - 32 - 16 - 44 = 298: 'Delivery charge by district' -> 'জেলা অনুযায়ী ডেলিভারি চার্জ' WRAPs to 2 lines at Bangla/Mobile/h3, header absorbs ~27px. 'Show 128 results' -> '128টি ফলাফল দেখুন' GROWs inside the FILL Button Size=Large, one line at 358. 'Your cart' -> 'আপনার কার্ট' GROW. Facet rows in the body are FILL x HUG minHeight 44 and wrap to 2 lines; the body scrolls. Header cap 40 Bangla characters, footer button cap 24. maxLines is set nowhere - truncation is forbidden.

ICONS / Phosphor, FILLED, fills only: icon/x (Close, 20px inside IconButton Medium), icon/arrow-right (Checkout iconRight), icon/caret-right (nav rows, 20, color/text/tertiary), icon/baby, icon/puzzle-piece, icon/car, icon/paint-brush, icon/books, icon/soccer-ball, icon/package, icon/whatsapp-logo (nav rows, 24 = size/icon-lg, color/text/secondary), icon/user (Sign-in button iconLeft). All exist in the file; newIcons is empty. Never set a stroke on an icon instance.

BUILD ORDER FOR THE LEAD: 1) confirm IconButton (manifest 06) and Button exist with the property names used here (icon, ariaLabel, focusVisible, loading / label, iconLeft, iconRight, iconLeftSwap, iconRightSwap, loading, focusVisible). 2) Build Modal (3 variants): header, body (clip + Overflow Vertical + maxHeight), footer; bind the 8 properties; set isExposedInstance on Close/Primary/Secondary; set the two `_scroll-edge` layers hidden. 3) Build Drawer (9 variants): per-corner radius bindings, Handle visible per Side, Body FILL vs HUG+max per the GEOMETRY notes, `_edge` visible; bind the 8 properties; expose the three nested instances. 4) Place the documentation instances (4 Modal, 4 Drawer) - the Bangla pairs override the text STYLE as well as the characters. 5) Build the five layoutFrames; the two detached trees (destructive confirm, Left nav, cart) are plain frames nesting Button / IconButton / Divider instances. 6) Re-check: no fill left on any wrapper (Header, TextBlock, Body, Handle, Totals are null), every Overlay is color/bg/overlay, no modal or drawer variant footprint includes a scrim, nothing intersects.
